gloss: neglect of one's health; unhealthy living

definitions.gloss: neglect of one's health; failure to take care of oneself
definitions.explanation: Living in a way that damages your own health — irregular hours, overwork, drinking too much, ignoring a doctor's advice. It is a mild, slightly old-fashioned reproach, often aimed at oneself.

examples.japanese: {不養生|ふようじょう}がたたった。
examples.english: My neglect of my health caught up with me.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}いころの{不養生|ふようじょう}を{後悔|こうかい}している。
examples.english: I regret how badly I looked after myself when I was young.

examples.japanese: {毎晩|まいばん}{夜更|よふ}かしをして{朝食|ちょうしょく}も{抜|ぬ}くようでは、{不養生|ふようじょう}と{言|い}われても{仕方|しかた}がない。
examples.english: If you stay up late every night and skip breakfast too, you can hardly complain about being told you neglect your health.

notes:
Formed from {不|ふ} (not) plus {養生|ようじょう} (taking care of one's health, convalescing). It names the behavior, not the illness that results.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {医者|いしゃ}の{不養生|ふようじょう}: "the doctor's own bad habits" — a set proverb for someone who preaches what they fail to practice
- {不養生|ふようじょう}がたたる: for neglect of one's health to catch up with one
- {日頃|ひごろ}の{不養生|ふようじょう}: one's habitual poor self-care

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不摂生|ふせっせい}: intemperance, unhealthy habits — a near-synonym, slightly more about excess (drink, food)
- {養生|ようじょう}: taking care of one's health, resting to recover — the positive counterpart
